formulas.meaning: For x²+sx+p, candidate constants a,b need both a+b=s and ab=p. One condition alone is insufficient. Regrouping also uses common factors: ax+ay+bx+by=a(x+y)+b(x+y)=(a+b)(x+y). A zero of a factored polynomial makes at least one factor zero.
